description:
## Problem
BenchBox caps pyspark `<4.3` (and delta-spark to match), but error messages and the platform registry tell users to run an unbounded `pip install pyspark`, which installs 4.3+ and breaks Delta sessions. Sites on develop (2026-11-17):
- `benchbox/platforms/__init__.py:380-381` (pyspark-df, lakesail-df registry rows)
- `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/pyspark_df.py:81`
- `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/lakesail_df.py:50`
- `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/pyspark_maintenance.py:115`
- `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/hudi_maintenance.py:79`
- `benchbox/core/transaction_primitives/dataframe_operations.py:229` (`pip install pyspark delta-spark`)

## Change
Point each hint at the extra (`uv add benchbox --extra pyspark` / `pip install "benchbox[pyspark]"`), matching the existing wording in `platforms/__init__.py`, so the cap comes from package metadata. Do not hard-code a version range in messages. Check docs for the same unbounded hint (`git grep "pip install pyspark" docs`).

## Guardrails
Messages only; no dependency or lock changes. Keep any existing tests that assert message text green by updating them to the new contract.
